cases.name: Dora Devalle Almontaser
cases.about: “Me and my sister was really close,” said Daniel Delvalle. “She always had a great heart. I think that’s how God made her.” According to her loved ones, she loved babysitting and hoped to become a mother one day.
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; COLD CASE SOLVED; CONVICTION
cases.narrative: On 12/2/2000, she was found dead at her uncle’s West Farms apartment in the Bronx, where she was housesitting. Her mother and brother found her face-up and naked on the bed with a phone cord wrapped around her neck.
